d: For Buddy Valastro, creating an incredible cake is only part of the fun. The real excitement comes when it's time to deliver the finished masterpiece! At Carlo's Bakery, Buddy and his talented cake artists turn creative cake designs, elaborate details and custom orders into amazing cakes ready for their big moment. From careful transport to the final reveal, these Cake Boss highlights celebrate the teamwork and professional cake decorating that go into every creation. Watch the journey from bakery to delivery, only on discovery+ India.
